text: In federated learning the communication cost of many edge devices sending model parameters to a central server frequently exceeds the computation cost, and heterogeneity in the participating devices, including varying computational capabilities and resource constraints, compounds the problem.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607
